anchor.formula: ILLIQ_i,t = mean over the D=21 most recent served sessions d<t of |r_i,d| / DV_i,d
anchor.r_definition: adjusted_close_i,d / adjusted_close_i,d-1 - 1 (guard class i: denominator >0 finite else name-day excluded+counted)
anchor.dv_definition: dollar_volume_contract.json frozen pair (adjusted_close x volume; guard class ii: DV >0 finite else name-day excluded+counted)
anchor.direction: LONG the most illiquid quintile (Amihud 2002 sign); frozen; never flipped after PnL

neighbour.formula: same with D=63 (the ONE neighbouring lookback; no other lookback ever computed)

reversal_control.construction: same machinery, same calendar, same eligibility, ranking axis = 5-session past return ASC (long the biggest 5-session losers)
reversal_control.adjudication: control earning >= 0.5x anchor same-sign in >= 2/3 folds => falsification-by-control REJECT (Q-11 kill vs null distinguished in verdict)

rebalance_calendar.decision_clock: decision at session t close; fills at t+1 open; book force-flat at each fold boundary
rebalance_calendar.grid: every 21 trading sessions from first eligible decision date (census grid 2019-01-02..2022-12-30, 48 dates, p0/f4_cohort_census.json)

membership.rule: top quintile by rank-count (no interpolation): sort eligible names by ILLIQ desc; N_book = min(ceil(0.20*N_eligible), N_eligible); ties by ticker lexicographic

weights.law: w_i = min(1/N_book, 0.15 * DVmed60_i / AUM_ref); AUM_ref = 1000000.00 USD frozen; cap excess to CASH (zero return), never redistributed; cap is provably inert at AUM_ref (disclosure in evaluation); capacity number = book AUM at which binding member first hits cap

bookability.floor: date bookable iff N_book >= 10 (i.e. N_eligible >= 46); else force-flat at t+1 open until next bookable date (counted)

eligibility.type: Common Stock, Exchange in {NASDAQ, NYSE, NYSE MKT, AMEX} (universe_frozen.json, 16572 codes)
eligibility.warmup: >= 252 served sessions before a name's first eligible decision (dynamic per name; first decision no earlier than its 253rd served session) — NOTE: p0 census warmup counts are static-at-grid-start lower bounds; the engine implements the dynamic law
eligibility.dv_floor: trailing 60-session median DV >= 2000000.00 USD (>=30 of 60 sessions present, else ineligible at t)
eligibility.served_bars: served bar at t and t+1 required (else name skipped, counted)

death_contract.law: held name whose served series ends before scheduled exit: position closed and marked at that name's FINAL served bar close; no forward fill, no synthetic bar, no invented haircut; counted in BC-7a census; PnL contribution reported separately

folds.law: frozen before any PnL; 2020-03 lives inside F2 alone; annual split reporting regardless (F3 also reported 2021 and 2022 separately); floors: >=30 executed position entries AND >=6 bookable dates per fold (bookable census: 12/13/23 PASS)

no_grid_search: no parameter of this contract may be varied inside the cycle; any change = new plan + new cycle
